name: Cybersecurity Foundations & Certification Preparation Program
program_overview: The Cybersecurity Foundations & Certification Preparation Program is a comprehensive 24-week online training program designed to prepare high school students, college students, career changers, and adult learners for entry-level cybersecurity careers and nationally recognized cybersecurity certification exams such as:

Throughout this 24-week program, students develop the technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and hands-on skills needed to identify cyber threats, protect digital assets, secure networks, respond to security incidents, and successfully pass a national cybersecurity certification exam.

Students engage in interactive lessons, virtual labs, realistic cyberattack simulations, quizzes, module exams, and AI-powered personalized tutoring that adapts instruction to each learner's strengths and growth areas.
Upon successful completion, students will be able to:
Explain fundamental cybersecurity principles and terminology.
Identify common cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors.
Apply security best practices to protect systems and networks.
Understand networking fundamentals and secure communication protocols.
Analyze malware, phishing, ransomware, and social engineering attacks.
Implement authentication, encryption, and access control measures.
Demonstrate knowledge of governance, risk management, compliance, and cybersecurity ethics.
Successfully prepare for a national cybersecurity certification examination.
